novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要技术将动态时序图压缩为固定规模的新图，解决GNN输出无法直接输入RNN训练的问题，并利用图自编码器与循环神经网络学习时序特征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which compresses dynamic sequential graphs into fixed-size new graphs via graph summarization, solving the problem that GNN outputs cannot be directly fed into RNN, and uses graph autoencoder and recurrent neural network to learn temporal features.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图压缩，生成固定规模的新图
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点表征
将单时间步图表征输入循环神经网络学习时间维度特征与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step
Compress the original graph via graph summarization to generate fixed-size new graphs
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder and train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Feed single-time-step graph representations into a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features and dependencies

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练框架DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，领导节点负责图划分与模型同步更新，工作者节点基于图摘要进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training framework DSGNN based on graph summarization, adopting a leader-worker mode where the leader performs graph partitioning and synchronous model updates, and workers conduct mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results through an attention layer.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图划分并分配子图给工作者节点
工作者节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Leader partitions the original graph using an edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm and assigns subgraphs to workers
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
Leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法Sketch-DBH，利用Count-Min Sketch存储节点度数信息，并使用最小堆维护高频节点信息，实现常数时间查询和负载均衡的子图划分。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose an edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm Sketch-DBH, which uses Count-Min Sketch to store node degree information and a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information, enabling constant-time queries and load-balanced subgraph partitioning.
technical_features: 使用Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
在常数时间内返回查询结果
根据节点度数信息生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号
确保负载均衡，加速模型训练
technical_features_en: Use Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure to store degree information of each node
Use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information in graph stream data
Return query results in constant time
Generate the subgraph ID to which each graph stream data item is assigned based on node degree information
Ensure load balancing and accelerate model training
